def quandle_representation(circuit):
    n = len(circuit)

        elif gate_type == 'OR':
            Q[i + 1][inputs[0]] = 1
            Q[i + 1][inputs[1]] = 1
            Q[n][i + 1] = -1
    return Q

    m, n = len(A), len(A[0])
    for i in range(m):
        max_row = i
        for j in range(i + 1, m):
            if abs(A[j][i]) > abs(A[max_row][i]):
